tours.sub: Arab-Norman cloister, crypt and sacred-art museum
ov: The cathedral of St Andrew stands at the top of 57 steps in Piazza Duomo. One ticket covers the Cloister of Paradise, the Basilica of the Crucifix with the Diocesan Museum, and the crypt of St Andrew.
The cloister was built in 1266–68 as a burial ground for Amalfi’s nobles and has interlaced Arab-style arches.
tours.tnote: Some guides quote €4; confirm at the ticket desk. Child and reduced fares: Verify. No separate non-EU or Indian-passport rate is published; Verify.
inc: Basilica of the Crucifix and Diocesan Museum
hl: Crypt holding the relics of St Andrew
Fountain of Sant’Andrea in the square outside
hrs: Open daily. Some sources show the Diocesan Museum closed on Mondays; Verify.
Hours change by season (about 09:00 to 18:45 in spring and summer, shorter in winter). Verify on the day.
Right at opening, before cruise and coach groups arrive.
tours.meet: Piazza Duomo, 84011 Amalfi. Walk from the ferry pier and the SITA bus stop takes about 3 minutes.
acc: The cathedral sits above 57 steps; a step-free route exists for visitors with reduced mobility: Verify with the cathedral.
Easy walking inside, with uneven old floors in the cloister.
rules: Shoulders and knees must be covered.
Quiet during services; photography limits in the church: Verify.
know: Entry to the nave during services is free but does not include the cloister and museum.
Sold from: Amalfi, Positano, Sorrento and Salerno as a stop on a coast day.
Weddings are common in summer and can close parts of the cathedral for short periods.
tours.canc: Walk-in ticket paid at the desk. Group booking terms: Verify.
faq: The church is free to enter outside paid hours, but the cloister, crypt and museum need the €3 ticket.
Plan 45 to 60 minutes including the steps.
also: Valley of the Mills, short walk
See the town from the sea
why: Easy 1-hour add-on in the town centre for any coast day.
Low ticket price; works for every age and budget.
how: Pair with a Marina Grande walk and a coffee at the square.
Suggest the first hour of the day to avoid group traffic.

tours.sub: Moorish cloister, terraces and the Belvedere over the sea
tours.lang: Self-guided; free guided tours on set dates
ov: A 13th-century villa in Ravello’s main square, known for its Moorish cloister, tower and terraced gardens above the coast.
In summer the Belvedere terrace hosts the Ravello Festival concerts.
tours.tnote: Child and reduced fares: Verify. No separate non-EU or Indian-passport rate is published; Verify.
inc: Free guided visit on scheduled dates (official programme)
hl: Terrace views over the Gulf of Salerno
Ravello Cathedral 30 m from the gate (free)
hrs: Open daily; the villa has opened later on special event mornings (for example 11 August 2026).
Hours are seasonal and extend in summer. Festival period 4 July to 5 September 2026 can change closing time. Verify.
Early morning, or late afternoon in summer.
tours.meet: Piazza Duomo, 84010 Ravello. Reached by SITA bus from Amalfi (about 25 minutes, Verify) or private transfer. The coach stop is a short walk from the square.
acc: Many steps and uneven paths; not suitable for wheelchairs on most routes: Verify.
Moderate walking with some climbs.
know: Ravello is a hill town; allow transfer time from the coast.
Sold from: Amalfi, Positano, Sorrento and Salerno.
Combine with Villa Cimbrone, a 10-minute walk along Via Santa Chiara.
tours.canc: Walk-in ticket paid at the gate. Group booking terms: Verify.
faq: On dates in the official programme the guided visit needs only the entry ticket.
Is the villa open during the festival?
Yes, but closing times can change in July to September. Check the day.
why: Classic postcard stop on every Ravello day.
Fixed low ticket price makes group costing simple.
how: Sell it as a pair with Villa Cimbrone.
Recommend an early visit in summer to avoid heat and queues.

tours.t: Villa Cimbrone Gardens & Terrace of Infinity
tours.sub: Ravello’s clifftop gardens above the sea
ov: Gardens beside a hotel estate on the cliff above Ravello, ending at the Terrace of Infinity with a line of busts facing the sea.
Allow time: the grounds are larger than Villa Rufolo.
tours.tnote: Guides quote €7 to €10; confirm at the gate. Reduced fares: Verify.
hl: Rose garden and temple of Bacchus
hrs: Hours are seasonal; Verify at the gate or with the estate.
tours.meet: Via Santa Chiara 26, 84010 Ravello. About 10 minutes on foot from Piazza Duomo.
acc: Paths with steps and slopes; limited step-free access: Verify.
know: The estate is also a hotel, so some areas are private.
Sold from: Amalfi, Positano, Sorrento and Salerno.
faq: Is it the same as Villa Rufolo?
No. They are separate villas with separate tickets, a 10-minute walk apart.
The Terrace of Infinity, ideally early.
why: Quieter and more scenic than the main square sights.
Good for slower, photo-focused groups.
how: Pair with Villa Rufolo on a half-day Ravello visit.
Warn guests about the walk from the bus stop.

tours.sub: Boat-in sea cave at Conca dei Marini
tours.entry: Ticket at cave or with boat transfer
tours.closed: Open daily; closes in rough seas
ov: A small sea cave about 5 km west of Amalfi, lit green by sunlight through an underwater opening. You tour it in a rowboat that holds around 20 people.
You can reach it by lift and stairs from the coast road, or by boat from Amalfi.
tiers: Boat transfer from Amalfi (excludes cave entry)
tours.tnote: Sources quote €5, €6, €7 and €10 for the cave. Boat transfers sold separately from cave entry. Verify before quoting.
hl: Green light effect, strongest around midday
hrs: Open daily; closes when the sea is rough.
About 10:00 to 16:30 as a rule; the boat transfer runs roughly March to November. Verify.
Around midday for the brightest colour.
tours.meet: Conca dei Marini, SS163 (about 5 km from Amalfi). Boats leave from Molo Pennello, Amalfi. By land: stairs or lift from the car park on the coast road.
acc: Stairs or lift to the pier; boarding a rowboat needs steady balance. Not suitable for wheelchair users: Verify.
know: Many coast boat tours stop outside but exclude the cave ticket.
Sold from: Amalfi, Positano and Sorrento (boat tours).
Tip expected by boatmen: Verify.
tours.canc: Weather closures follow the operator’s terms. Verify.
faq: Is the cave ticket in the boat tour price?
What if the sea is rough?
Access can close without notice, so keep a flexible plan.
why: Short, low-cost highlight for a free half-day.
Strong photo moment for family groups.
how: State clearly that cave entry is extra.
Offer a Plan B for rough-sea days.

tours.t: Path of the Gods Hike (Bomerano to Nocelle)
ov: A high trail along the cliffs above Praiano and Positano with wide views of the coast and Capri. The usual route runs from Bomerano (Agerola) to Nocelle.
The route has no ticket. Guided and transfer-inclusive versions are sold by operators.
tours.tnote: Transfers and guide prices vary by operator. Verify.
hl: Views of Capri and the Li Galli islands
steps: Reach Bomerano
Bus or transfer to the start in Agerola.
Walk the trail
Mostly level with some climbs; carry water.
Finish at Nocelle
Onward by bus or steps down to Positano (long, steep stairs).
hrs: Walk in daylight. Avoid after heavy rain.
tours.meet: Start at Bomerano, Agerola (bus from Amalfi, Verify). End at Nocelle, above Positano.
acc: Strenuous for some guests: uneven stone and steps, no shade in places.
Not suitable for wheelchairs or strollers.
know: Take water and sun protection.
Descending from Nocelle to Positano is a long staircase; many guests take the bus.
Sold from: Amalfi, Positano and Sorrento (transfers).
tours.canc: Free to walk. Guided tour terms: Verify.
faq: Yes, the trail has no entry fee.
Moderate, with uneven ground; suited to active guests.

tours.sub: Medieval paper mill in the Valley of the Mills
ov: A museum in a 13th-century paper mill in the Valle dei Mulini, a 15-minute walk from Piazza Duomo. It shows how Amalfi produced paper and includes a working demonstration.
tours.tnote: Ticket price and demonstration times: Verify with the museum.
tours.meet: Valle dei Mulini, Amalfi, about 15 minutes’ walk from Piazza Duomo. Exact address: Verify.
acc: Uphill walk and stairs; accessibility: Verify.
know: Sold from: Amalfi only as a town add-on.
faq: In the Valley of the Mills, uphill from the town centre.
Handmade paper is sold on site: Verify.
why: Low-cost cultural stop for slower days.
how: Pair with the cathedral and a walk through the valley.

capri.sub: Hydrofoils from Naples, Sorrento and the coast
ov: Hydrofoils from Naples and Sorrento serve Marina Grande. Sorrento is the shortest crossing at about 20–25 minutes. A guide quotes Naples round trip about €40–€50 by hydrofoil and about €28–€40 slow ferry. A funicular or bus ride on the island is about €2.40.
